scripts.check:packages: bun run check:publish-dry-run && bun run check:package-consumer
scripts.build:imagejob: bun run applik8s build examples/imagejob.ts --out-dir dist/applik8s
scripts.build:guestbook: bun run applik8s build examples/guestbook.ts --typekro --composition-name guestBookStack --out-dir dist/examples/guestbook
scripts.build:tenant-platform-v04: bun run applik8s build examples/tenant-platform.ts --typekro --composition-name tenantPlatformV04 --out-dir dist/examples/tenant-platform-v04
scripts.lint: biome lint . && node scripts/check-typecasts.mjs && node scripts/check-static-imports.mjs && node scripts/check-test-taxonomy.mjs && bun run check:runtime-contract && bun run check:docs-consistency && bun run check:release
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.test:v03:local: bun run test:v03:contracts && bun run test:v03:generated
scripts.test:v03:live: APPLIK8S_E2E=1 APPLIK8S_E2E_LIVE=1 bunx vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts packages/e2e/test/tenant-platform-live.e2e.test.ts packages/e2e/test/typekro-modelstore-postgres.e2e.test.ts packages/e2e/test/typekro-operation-target.e2e.test.ts packages/e2e/test/typekro-scoped-listener.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:v03:live:orbstack: APPLIK8S_E2E=1 APPLIK8S_E2E_LIVE=1 APPLIK8S_E2E_CONTEXT=orbstack bunx vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts packages/e2e/test/tenant-platform-live.e2e.test.ts packages/e2e/test/typekro-modelstore-postgres.e2e.test.ts packages/e2e/test/typekro-operation-target.e2e.test.ts packages/e2e/test/typekro-scoped-listener.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:v04:wasm-live: APPLIK8S_E2E=1 APPLIK8S_E2E_LIVE=1 bunx vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts packages/e2e/test/kubernetes-sdk-wasm-live.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:v04:tenant-live: APPLIK8S_E2E=1 APPLIK8S_E2E_LIVE=1 APPLIK8S_E2E_V04=1 bunx vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts packages/e2e/test/tenant-platform-live.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:v04:contracts: bun run build:packages && bunx vitest run packages/core/test/application-graph.vertical.test.ts packages/applik8s/test/application-commands.vertical.test.ts packages/applik8s/test/model-store-postgres-runtime.vertical.test.ts packages/applik8s/test/model-command-processor-runtime.vertical.test.ts packages/applik8s/test/event-log-jetstream-runtime.vertical.test.ts packages/compiler/test/compiler-artifacts.vertical.test.ts packages/compiler/test/tenant-v04-proof.vertical.test.ts packages/compiler/test/wasm-component.vertical.test.ts
scripts.test:v04:live: bun run test:v04:wasm-live && bun run test:v04:tenant-live
scripts.check:v04:local: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test:v04:local && bun run test:character && bun run check:packages && bun run check:v04:scorecard
scripts.check:v04:scorecard: TYPEKRO_LOG_LEVEL=fatal bun run scripts/check-v04-scorecard.ts && node scripts/verify-v04-live-evidence.mjs --self-test
scripts.benchmark:v041: bun run build:packages && bun run scripts/benchmark-v041.ts
scripts.benchmark:v041:record: bun run build:packages && bun run scripts/benchmark-v041.ts --record
scripts.check:v041:performance: bun run build:packages && bun run scripts/benchmark-v041.ts --quick
scripts.check:v041:local: bun run check:v04:local && bun run check:v041:performance
scripts.check:v04:prerelease: bun run check:v04:local && bun run test:v04:live
scripts.check:v03:local: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test:v03:local && bun run test:character
scripts.check:v03:prerelease: bun run check:v03:local && bun run test:v03:live
scripts.check:v03:prerelease:orbstack: bun run check:v03:local && bun run test:v03:live:orbstack
